findings.title: Schema-invalid reports are accepted as complete reviews
findings.trigger: Supply a report with every required key present, valid matching head/base SHAs, and null values for all remaining fields.
findings.execution_path: Contract invocation step 6 calls main → assess_report → _check_schema. Presence checks pass; null verdict bypasses enum validation, non-list findings/commands bypass their validation, and null coverage bypasses the empty-coverage check. Assessment becomes complete, so main would return 0.
findings.consequence: A report with no usable scope, coverage, commands, summary, verdict, or findings can satisfy the manual Codex completion check and avoid the documented incomplete/retry path.
findings.evidence: The reproduction returned Assessment(status='complete', reasons=(), qualified_ids=(), finding_count=0). The schema requires strings and arrays for these fields. Existing tests cover missing keys and selected enum violations, but not required-field nulls, incorrect container types, schema_version values, or most nested field types.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate every schema node recursively, including types, nullable unions, enums, array items, required fields, and additional properties. Reject booleans where integers are required. Add parameterized negative tests for null/wrong-type values at every level and ensure malformed reports return incomplete.

findings.title: Checkpoint comment update command has invalid field syntax
findings.trigger: Follow the documented procedure to update an existing head's checkpoint after a retry or delayed review finishes.
findings.execution_path: The checkpoint procedure invokes gh api with --field body@FILE; gh rejects the argument during local parsing because it lacks the key=value separator.
findings.consequence: The authoritative checkpoint comment cannot be refreshed using the prescribed command and retains stale status/evidence until the operator repairs the invocation.
findings.evidence: Running the documented placeholder command exited 1 with invalid key: "body@FILE". Existing instruction tests check links and literal safeguard phrases, not command validity.
findings.suggested_fix: Use --field 'body=@FILE', substituting the actual prepared file path and comment ID. Add a local command-shape guard or a mocked CLI test for the documented update invocation.
